newsitem.title: USA: BPA lack of surplus power deemed normal for season.
newsitem.headline: BPA lack of surplus power deemed normal for season.

text.p: A recent lack of surplus power sales from the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is fairly typical for this time of year, regional industry sources said Wednesday.
"Right now they are just operating along the curve," said one utility market source. "The (hydroelectric dam) system is being run to produce just enough power to meet loads."
With reservoir levels mostly on target, dam operators are trying to sustain generation rather than run full out.
"After the end of the water year, hydro operators tend to get real conservative," said the industry source.
